descriptionHtml: DecoLib is the library mod that contains the actual code for mirroring weapons, and is required for Mirror.
aiDescription: Contains the actual implementation logic for mirroring weapons. It is designed as a dependency for other mods that wish to implement similar visual or behavioral changes without requiring the full Mirror mod.

gallery.aiCaption: A large, symmetrical ship design featuring orange and grey mechanical components with multiple engine thrusters.

changelog.0.3:
Updated for Starsector 0.97a
Changed mod to work via included jar file instead of uncompiled scripts
The source code is still included; you can find it inside the jar
changelog.0.2:
Updated for Starsector 0.96a
Implemented mirroring for animated weapons
Added a 0.1 degree margin of error for deciding that a weapon counts as pointing forwards i.e. 'forwards' is considered to be turret angles from -90.1 to 90.1
this is relevant for ORA hulls, whose turret layouts include subtle asymmetries to help address AI issues with broadside ships.
Removed special handling intended for 0.95.1's buggy asymmetric missile turrets
